items.label: Process view
items.text: Process shows the steps of the training and how long each took; Model view shows how the model learns (a labelled illustration while it trains, then views of your trained model); Results switches back to the numbers.

items.label: Training steps
items.text: Each step is one thing the engine really did, for example loading the BMW i3 data or fitting the model, with a plain description and its time. Below the steps, a log lists the engine's own messages with times.
